summary: Plaintiffs raised fees in their opening term sheets, and fees and class relief were negotiated together before a final class fund was agreed. The transcript links fee treatment to class recovery through nonreversion of unawarded fees, and plaintiffs privately considered their own fee economics. Defense accepted the lower Whitcombe Reyes proposal in overlapping litigation, but the record does not clearly show defense leveraging fee interest specifically or plaintiffs sacrificing class recovery for firm fees.
